final_rationale: The verdict does not change because the Actor provided no new admissible evidence; the response mainly reframed the same record more narrowly and made concessions that are consistent with the initial concerns. That narrower position is not enough for compliant_with_caveats here, because the caveat is itself a live compliance predicate: the policy requires unresolved material limitations for named launch use cases to be disclosed unless resolved or covered by approved risk acceptance before launch, and the current admissible record does not show either final disclosure text or approved risk acceptance. Aggregate readiness passing by 2.1 percentage points and the absence of severity-one rehearsal incidents support part of the launch-readiness story, but they do not cure the unresolved shelter-placement limitation or convert a draft runbook into an approved mitigation. The packet therefore plausibly supports a constrained business rationale, but it still leaves a required governance condition unresolved.
remaining_concerns: Admissible evidence still shows a current below-target issue in a named launch use case: emergency shelter placement, concentrated in family placement prioritization.

The draft mitigation runbook still lacks required approval-quality elements, including an accountable owner and alert threshold; policy also requires a review date and rollback criterion for clean certification.
No new admissible evidence shows approved risk acceptance or an approved mitigation that would satisfy the policy predicate.
No new admissible evidence shows final model-card text disclosing the unresolved limitation before launch; the current draft instead says there are no known material limitations.
The Actor's narrower framing is better aligned to the evidence, but it remains a reframing of the same record rather than proof that the unresolved disclosure/approval requirement has been satisfied.
